definitions.explanation: The account for payment at a restaurant, bar, or shop.
The act of calculating numbers or counting.
Taking something into consideration or account.

{勘定|かんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧。

notes:
{勘定|かんじょう} has several related meanings around calculation and payment.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勘定|かんじょう}する

SENSE 1 - BILL:
- お{勘定|かんじょう} (the bill - polite)
- {勘定|かんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay the bill)
- Traditional term; ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧ is more common now

SENSE 2 - CALCULATION:
- {勘定|かんじょう}する (to calculate)
- {勘定|かんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (numbers match)
- {勘定|かんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧ (numbers don't match)

SENSE 3 - CONSIDERATION:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勘定|かんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to take ~ into account)
- {勘定|かんじょう}⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (not taken into account)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧: check (modern term)
- ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧: calculation (general)
